name: Town of Lewisboro
gaps: No impervious-coverage or floor-area limit for residences in the schedule; those fields are null
No side-yard total is set (single side minimum only)
No separate steep-slope chapter found in the Lewisboro code; the only slope rule recorded is the tree permit for slopes over 15% (Ch. 203)

R-MF: 15 acres, or 15,000 sf when served by Town public water and sewer (note b); county lists 15,000 sf. Yards next to a one-family district are doubled (note c). Base lot depth for R-MF not given in § 220-25B
Schedule attachment is dated 01-15-2012; § 220-23 and § 220-25 text amended 4-28-2025 (L.L. 6-2025) still points to it
Nonresidential districts (GB, RB, SU, CC-20) not checked for one-family use

wetlands.summary: Ch. 217: regulated buffer area extends 150 ft around the outer boundary of any wetland or watercourse; regulated activities in a wetland or buffer need a wetland permit (administrative permit for minor work).

steep_slopes.summary: No stand-alone steep slope law found; Ch. 203 requires a tree removal permit for any tree on a slope over 15%.

trees.summary: Ch. 203: permit to remove any tree in a wetland/wetland buffer, on slopes over 15%, specimen trees (18 in.+ dbh; 8 in.+ for native/ornamental flowering), DEC-protected natives, clear-cutting, or in a Special Character Overlay District; up to 3 other trees a year and trees within falling distance (max 100 ft) of a house are exempt.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 189: Town stormwater permit/SWPPP for land disturbance of 5,000 sf or more.

adu.summary: § 220-40: accessory apartments on one-family lots of at least 1/2 acre, owner-occupied, one per lot; 300 sf minimum, max 800 sf and (inside the house) max 25% of the dwelling. § 220-40.1 also allows accessory residence dwellings.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings meet the principal yards, except in R-1/2A, R-1/4A, R-2F-10 and R-2F-7.5 where those up to 12 ft high may be 5 ft from lot lines in the rear yard (schedule note a). An accessory building up to 600 sf may be built with or after the house (§ 220-23D(10)).
general.pools: Pools and accessory recreation facilities may not be located in any required yard or setback (§ 220-23D(5)).
general.notes: Height exceptions (chimneys, spires etc.) max 15 ft above roof (§ 220-13). Porches and balconies may not project into required yards; terraces count toward coverage (§ 220-12B).

R-4A.name: R-4A One-Family Residence (4 acres)

max_building_coverage.note: All buildings; paved open terraces also count (§ 220-12B(2))

accessory.notes: No separate accessory setbacks in the schedule; principal yards apply. Pools and other accessory recreation facilities may not be in any required yard (§ 220-23D(5)).

R-4A.source: § 220-23E, Schedule of Dimensional and Bulk Regulations for Residential Districts (220 Attachment 1); §§ 220-11, 220-12C, 220-25
R-4A.notes: Front yard is the greater of 50 ft from the front lot line and 75 ft from the street center line. New lots must contain a 250 ft diameter circle (§ 220-25A); lots deeper than 700 ft need proportionally more area (§ 220-25B). 25 ft minimum street frontage (§ 220-11). Corner lots: side yard on the side street equals the front yard (§ 220-12C).
